Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the genealogical relationships by confusing Blanche’s paternal grandmother (the mother of her father, Afonso III) with her paternal great-grandmother (Afonso II’s mother). Despite the Afonso III page explicitly stating his mother is Urraca of Castile, the Planner concluded Dulce of Aragon, who is actually Blanche’s great-grandmother. This generational mix-up and failure to synthesize the just-collected evidence led to the incorrect final answer.
